# Rollback Drill Decision: Atlas Rehearsals

**Date:** 2026-07-02
**Participants:** Quinton Fairweather (CTO)

Quinton: "Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on. A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have."

Key decisions:
- **Cadence**: monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals
- **Owner**: Quinton Fairweather

Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on. A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.
segments.note: Directive instituting a recurring practice, justified by an accompanying assertion in the same quoted turn; kept as one segment since both sentences serve the single move of establishing the cadence.
Bulleted decision-record item restating the cadence set by Quinton's quoted directive above.
Ownership assignment recorded in the decision list.

evidence.quote:

we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: an unrehearsed rollback is opposed to a rollback one 'actually has' — the second clause mirrors and negates the first.

observations.why: Equating an unrehearsed rollback with not having one frames rehearsal as the condition for security, while the aphoristic construction asserts mastery over the capability.
Setting a recurring cadence for rehearsals appeals to stability and security through regularity.
Naming an owner assigns personal accountability for the capability, appealing to mastery and craft ownership.

mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have

positions.name: CadenceMandateAuthority
positions.frame: Is authority over the rehearsal cadence being enacted here through unilateral declaration, and does restating it as a fixed spec parameter reinforce or merely echo that declaration?
positions.why: Both expressions carry the relational dimension's shared authority-ranking mint (MandateByDeclaration): src-1 performs the mandate directly ('run monthly from now on') and backs it with an aphoristic warrant equating unrehearsed capability with no capability, while src-2 restates the same cadence flatly as a settled label under a **Cadence** heading. Read together, the cadence is established once by unilateral directive and then normalized into administrative fact rather than negotiated or revisited — the same authority move performed twice, in two registers (justified directive, then bare spec line). src-3's ownership self-assignment is a related authority act but was not tagged with the same relational mint across the dimensional reads, so it is left out of this group rather than folded in on a loose thematic match.

placements.why: The document sets a recurring operational cadence (monthly rollback rehearsals), names a fixed owner, and frames the whole as an ongoing institutional discipline rather than a one-off engagement deliverable. Nothing in the supplied strata (none yet minted) or the surfaced Strategy-area leaves (Diagnostic First Methodology, Knowledge Gap Mapping) is about recurring internal operational process ownership — those are client-engagement methodology decisions. No existing category holds organizational/operational-cadence content, so a new top-level category is warranted rather than forcing this under Strategy.
placements.title: operational commitments only exist once they are owned and scheduled
placements.frame: Does this material describe how the organization assigns ownership and cadence to a recurring operational commitment, as distinct from strategy, product, or architecture content?

placements.title: a capability is only real once it has been rehearsed and owned
placements.frame: Does this expression treat rehearsal (and a named owner enforcing it) as the mechanism that converts a claimed operational capability into a proven, standing one?
placements.why: src-1 performs the directive and supplies the load-bearing aphorism equating an unrehearsed rollback with no rollback at all — a directional claim about what makes a capability real, not a one-time fact. src-2 restates the cadence as the concrete instantiation of that claim (monthly, not ad hoc), and src-3 names the owner who makes the discipline enforceable rather than aspirational. Together these are the first instance of a theme future envelopes about rehearsal cadence, drill outcomes, or capability audits would keep feeding — not a single measurable event, so it clears the narrative grain test rather than being logged as a bare fact. No existing leaf in the supplied structure (Diagnostic First Methodology, Knowledge Gap Mapping) touches operational rehearsal or capability-through-practice; both surfaced leaves concern client-facing engagement methodology, a different subject.
